title: Learn How to Dance High Heels in 15 min | Tutorial for Beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down each movement into precise physical components like posture and weight distribution. She demonstrates step-by-step with continuous verbal guidance and counts.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the high heels tutorial and overview of five easy moves.
Detailed instruction of the first move: The Walk.
Detailed instruction of the second move: Hip Slide.
Detailed instruction of the third move: Hip Deep Slide.
Detailed instruction of the fourth move: Hair Wipe.

metaphors: The cherry on the cake is our head
safety: If you don't feel comfortable in the high heels for now, you can start with any shoes.

steps_taught.name: The Walk
steps_taught.description: Stepping with weight shifts and ankle coordination.

steps_taught.name: Hip Slide
steps_taught.description: Isolating and sliding hips side to side with bent knees.

steps_taught.name: Hip Deep Slide
steps_taught.description: Deeper hip slide with feet wider than shoulder-width.

steps_taught.name: Hair Wipe
steps_taught.description: Upper body circles and hair whip combined with hip slides.

what_works: Breaking down complex movements into numbered parts
Showing both front and side posture views

quotes.text: Today we're gonna learn five easy and beautiful moves in the high heels.
The most important in a high heels, it's how you feel yourself.
I'm gonna divide step into three pieces.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing front and verbally instructs starting position with posture adjustments.
Teacher turns to the side to demonstrate posture from a lateral angle.

extraction.distinctive_method: Emphasizing internal feeling and comfort over strict technical perfection before teaching any footwork.
